# hands/gh

the only holder of the GitHub token.

## How to call it

Run it from the repository root with your shell (exec) tool: `hands/gh <verb> [flags]`.

- A verb that takes a body reads one JSON object from stdin. Everything else is flags.
- It prints one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 is success. Exit 2 is a refusal by a rule, the guard or a cap: read the `rule` and `reason`, and do not retry it unchanged. Any other exit is an error.
- Secrets belong to the hand; you never see them and never pass one.
- The hand runs the guard, its caps and `DRY_RUN` itself. `DRY_RUN` is on unless the box turned it off; under it an acting verb checks every rule and sends nothing. Do not try to go around the hand, and do not look for another way to do what it refused.

## Side effects

- Acting (side effects in the world, each goes through the guard and the caps): create-repo; push; open-pr; comment; fork; open-issue; close-issue
- Job (writes state or calls the core): none
- Operator only (never call): none
- Read only: whoami; repo OWNER/REPO; issues OWNER/REPO [--label L] [--max N]; pr OWNER/REPO NUMBER; contributing OWNER/REPO; checks OWNER/REPO NUMBER; activity [--days N]; notifications [--max N]

## Verbs

| Verb | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `whoami` | R | The token's account, and whether it `matches` `GITHUB_USER`. |
| `repo OWNER/REPO` | R | One repository (cached 10 minutes). |
| `issues OWNER/REPO [--label L] [--max N]` | R | Open issues, pull requests left out (10 minutes). |
| `pr OWNER/REPO NUMBER` | R | One pull request (5 minutes). |
| `contributing OWNER/REPO` | R | Reads `AI_POLICY.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` (root, `.github/`, `docs/`) and says whether the project forbids AI-, LLM- or bot-made contributions: `{forbids_ai, verdict: forbids\|allows\|silent, files, evidence}`. |
| `checks OWNER/REPO NUMBER` | R | A pull request's `state`, `merged`, head ref and sha, and the check runs on its head by name: `red` (failure, timed out, cancelled, action required), `pending` and `green`. |
| `activity [--days N]` | R | Teeny's own pull requests opened and merged and its commits over the last N days (default 7), for the ship log (10 minutes). |
| `create-repo` | A | `{name, description?, private?}`. |
| `push` | A | `{workdir, repo, branch, message, base?}`. |
| `open-pr` | A | `{repo, head, base, title, body}`. |
| `comment` | A | `{repo, number, body}`. |
| `fork` | A | `{repo}`, somebody else's. |
| `open-issue` | A | `{repo, title, body, labels?}`. |
| `close-issue` | A | `{repo, number, comment?}`, on an own repo only: the comment first, then the issue closed as completed. |
| `notifications [--max N]` | R | What `ingest` read, newest first, and what became of each (`offered`, `held`, `skipped`, with why). |

Kinds: R = read: no side effect beyond its read cache; A = acting: posts, sends, pays or opens something in the world; O = operator-only: the operator runs it, never you; J = job: writes state or calls the core, says nothing to anyone; scheduled jobs run it, you do not.

Verbs named in the hand's source: `activity`, `checks`, `contributing`, `ingest`, `issues`, `notifications`, `pr`, `repo`, `whoami`.

Flags named in the hand's source: `--days`, `--label`, `--max`.

For one verb's exact flags, run `DRY_RUN=1 hands/gh <verb> --help`. The full account is in docs/hands.md.
